courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 昂船洲大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」與「氣彈模型試驗與施工期抗風驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；昂船洲大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters" and "Aeroelastic model testing and construction-stage wind checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Stonecutters Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦長江口軟弱深厚地層上的 1,088 m 斜張橋：摩擦樁群、300 m 塔、阻尼限位體系與長索控制；昂船洲大橋則以颱風區千米跨斜張橋：分離雙箱梁氣動、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與混凝土背跨的整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 1,088 m cable-stayed span on deep soft estuary ground: friction pile groups, 300 m towers, damper–limiter system and long-stay control; Stonecutters Bridge centres on A typhoon-zone 1 km cable-stayed span: split twin-box aerodynamics, composite stainless monopole towers and concrete back spans, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」與「中央開槽雙箱梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到昂船洲大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Tower–deck viscous dampers” and “Split twin-box deck”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Stonecutters Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
history.text: 蘇通大橋連接江蘇蘇州與南通，初步設計由中交公路規劃設計院、江蘇省交通規劃設計院與同濟大學聯合體承擔，2003 年 6 月開工，主橋由中國交通建設集團第二航務工程局總承包，英國 Dorman Long Technology 負責重型提升，AECOM 為承包商提供架設分析、線形控制與風工程服務。主梁於 2007 年 6 月合龍，2008 年 5 月試通車、6 月 30 日正式通車，以 1,088 m 主跨刷新斜張橋紀錄，並以 300.4 m 的塔與約 577 m 的斜索創下當時紀錄；2010 年獲美國土木工程師學會傑出土木工程成就獎。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: Sutong Bridge links Suzhou and Nantong in Jiangsu. Preliminary design was by a consortium of the CCCC Highway Planning and Design Institute, Jiangsu Provincial Communications Planning and Design Institute and Tongji University; construction began in June 2003 with CCCC Second Navigational Engineering Bureau as general contractor, Dorman Long Technology of the UK handling heavy lifts and AECOM providing erection analysis, geometry control and wind engineering to the contractor. The deck closed in June 2007, trial traffic began in May 2008 and the bridge officially opened on 30 June 2008, setting a cable-stayed span record of 1,088 m with record 300.4 m towers and stays of about 577 m; in 2010 it received ASCE’s Outstanding Civil Engineering Achievement award. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」到「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
